column3: Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says the children were born to him; BSB says he had them.
The Hebrew calls the eastern people sons of the east.
The Hebrew explicitly says each son held the feast on his day; BSB describes taking turns.
The Hebrew uses bless euphemistically where BSB says cursed; it says sons rather than children.
